s.zh: 的灵魂被深渊浸透，连命匣也染上了黑色：复活所需的时间延长一半。
s.en: 's soul is soaked through by the Abyss and even the phylactery has turned black: revival takes half again as long.

s.zh: 彻底拥抱了深渊：成了“深渊宠儿”，伤害+10%。阿斯莫看见它会不舒服。
s.en: has fully embraced the Abyss: now an "abyssal favorite", damage +10%. Aasimar feel uneasy seeing it.

s.zh: 的身体终于向深渊屈服了：皮肤下透出暗红，额头顶出一对角——
s.en: 's body has finally yielded to the Abyss: dark red shows through the skin and a pair of horns pushes out of the forehead.

s.zh: 成了坎比恩。腐化回落到 60%，但这一步无法逆转。
s.en: has become a cambion. Taint falls back to 60%, but this step can't be undone.

s.zh: 殖民地里有身带恶魔之印的人
s.en: Someone in the colony bears the demon's mark

s.zh: 到了“恶魔之印”以后不再自然消退。
s.en: Stops fading naturally once it reaches "demon's mark".

s.zh: 去除：向善神祈祷 -5%、阿斯莫的治疗之手 -8%、睡在驱魔结界里每天 -1%。
s.en: Removal: praying to a good god -5%, an aasimar's healing hands -8%, sleeping inside a warding seal -1% per day.

s.zh: 深渊腐化遮住了天界的光（“阴影”阶段以上不能用天界启示）。
s.en: Abyssal taint blocks the heavenly light (celestial revelation can't be used at "shadow" stage or above).
